effects.display_name: Ghostly Pickaxe Native Mining and Detached Storage Boundary
effects.actual_behavior: IRON Pickaxe parent constructor supplies TOOL plus tier durability; native speed 20 for MINEABLE_WITH_PICKAXE else 1. Full Player inventory means free slot == -1. Native mineBlock awards block stat and exhaustion float .005, server computes drops then attempts insertion and spawnAfterBreak(true)/XP, then always parent Item.mineBlock (server nonzero hardness/positive TOOL damage uses MAINHAND). Global ordinary-drop suppression is reviewed separately; no duplicate-free outcome inferred from this helper. putItem helper copies CUSTOM_DATA, creates fresh SimpleContainer(9), and its contains Items branch is empty: existing items are never loaded. Player.inventory.add first; otherwise adds to temporary container, puts an EMPTY ListTag into detached copy, and only leftover is spawned. No setCustomData/set component anywhere in storage paths: successfully accepted temporary items are lost, not persistent ghost storage. inventoryTick every 3 also fresh empty container, so retrieval loop never processes saved items and GhostItemCounts local copy is not persisted. Tooltip/dropAllContents null compound branches unreachable, destruction has no stored contents to release. Repair is PHANTOM_MEMBRANE. Current loader ItemStack.getMaxDamage delegates getItem().getMaxDamage(this), so native maximum 700 is active, independent of tier MAX_DAMAGE component; current damageable admission requires MAX_DAMAGE and DAMAGE components, supplied by TieredItem constructor. No invented magic inventory.
